method: Independent source/diff and test/assertion review; AST comparison of scoring body and all SCAN_* defaults; parsed existing author JUnit. No application imports, services, network or runtime calls.

code_evidence.cache_invalidation: market_scanner.py::scan clears both caches before first await
code_evidence.caller_invalidation: live_engine.py::_live_tick_inner MARKET SCAN assigns empty result and clears on exception

accepted_checks: Provider-shaped most-actives without price and movers without volume reach a shared snapshot batch; missing values are deferred, malformed supplied values remain rejected.

Every returned candidate requires a complete numeric finite positive valid daily OHLC and nonnegative integral volume snapshot, then unchanged inclusive price/volume thresholds. Missing or invalid snapshots cannot be repaired with old candidates or supplied screener data.
Current failures and empty scans clear candidate/detail caches before I/O. Caller assignment clears scanner pool on empty result and exception while retaining current base/held universe.
One failed discovery endpoint may still yield independently qualified candidates from successful endpoints; snapshot timeout produces empty current result.
Tension calculation body is unchanged apart from unused minute-volume assignment removal; seven weights, all SCAN_* settings, exclusions, sorting and cap remain unchanged.
Feed selection remains from existing ALPACA_DATA_FEED; test confirms configured iex is propagated without switching production feed.

Tests exercise actual recorded provider field shapes, inclusive filter edges, absent snapshots, malformed scalars and structures, NaN/infinity/bool/string/huge/fractional volumes, batching/deduplication, cache invalidation and diagnostics.
Actual scanner-to-replay tests exercise qualified discovery causing a real gated fill and subsequent empty/error pool clearing while held symbols remain in universe.
limitations: Snapshot event/session timestamp validation is unchanged; this review establishes schema/value qualification and absence of stale internal candidate reuse, not real-time provider recency. Actual feature-bar final entry age remains independently required.
Optional minute/prior-day missing-field scoring defaults remain intentionally unchanged; no new scoring or strategy tuning was approved.

Empty or failed scanner pools do not remove previously injected symbols from the current universe. This is explicit preserved base/held-universe behavior, not a promise that stale symbols vanish from all rankings.

Offline contracts and replay do not establish live endpoint/stream reliability, trade expectancy or profitability. Root owns complete required suites, freeze/runtime snapshot, hosted validation and future controlled deployment.
